name: nexo-assist
description: Nexo Assist: agent de atendimento do service desk de TI (desafio técnico Beyond the Bytes)

scripts.seed: npm run seed --workspace @nexo/tickets && npm run reset --workspace @nexo/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n tickets,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @nexo/tickets" "npm run dev --workspace @nexo/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n tickets,web -c blue,green "npm run start --workspace @nexo/tickets" "npm run start --workspace @nexo/web"
